jobs.title: Graduate Engineer Trainee - Process Engineering
jobs.description:
**Location:** Vengal, Tiruvallur


**Department**: Process Engineering


**Description:**


The Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Process Engineering supports the process engineering team in developing, documenting and improving the blade manufacturing processes on the shop floor. The GET learns design, tooling and process validation activities under the guidance of senior process engineers and works in AutoCAD, CATIA and Microsoft Office tools.


**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Support the process team in daily shopfloor process monitoring and ensure that the defined process is followed.
* Assist in preparing and updating WI, SOP and other process documents according to the change management.
* Prepare 2D drawings and 3D models for jigs, fixtures, templates and tools under guidance.
* Work closely with the tooling team to design \& detail new tools, jigs \& fixtures and support their validation and handover to Production, Maintenance, Quality and Safety.
* Provide the required inspection templates for parts / moulds.
* Support nesting, material layout and kitting activities for the prefab and shell teams.
* Participate in new tool trials, validation and documentation, and co\-ordinate with the global tooling team.
* Collect and analyses process data (CT, manhours, waste, material consumption, power, water, 3M, etc.,) using Excel and support continuous improvement projects.
* Support material trials to reduce the cost of blades.
* Assist in conducting process audits and follow up on the corrective actions.
* Support Production teams with technical training and skill development on shop floor processes.
* Ensure that all safety and quality standards are met.
* Participate in the shopfloor daily review meetings.

**Key skills:**


* Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes and engineering drawings.
* Preparation of WI, SOP etc.,
* Trials co\-ordination, validation \& documentation.
* Good communication and shop floor co\-ordination.
* CAD \& design skills in in AutoCAD, CATIA (SolidWorks / Creo / similar tools are also acceptable).
* MS Office

**Qualification:**


* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical / Production / Industrial / Mechatronics / Composites or a related discipline (fresher or up to 1 year of experience).

*Severely disabled applicants and applicants of equal status will be given special consideration in the event of equal suitability.*


*The role is generally available on a full\-time basis as well as in other flexible working\-time models.*

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.


**Job description**
-------------------


This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.


Join us as a Software Engineer

  

  

* This is an opportunity for a driven Software Engineer to take on an exciting new career challenge
* Day\-to\-day, you'll build a wide network of stakeholders of varying levels of seniority
* It’s a chance to hone your existing technical skills and advance your career
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

In your new role, you’ll engineer and maintain innovative, customer centric, high performance, secure and robust solutions.

  

  

You’ll be working within a feature team and using your extensive experience to engineer software, scripts and tools that are often complex, as well as liaising with other engineers, architects and business analysts across the platform.

  

  

You’ll also be:

  

  

* Producing complex and critical software rapidly and of high quality which adds value to the business
* Working in permanent teams who are responsible for the full life cycle, from initial development, through enhancement and maintenance to replacement or decommissioning
* Collaborating to optimise our software engineering capability
* Designing, producing, testing and implementing our working code
* Working across the life cycle, from requirements analysis and design, through coding to testing, deployment and operations
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  

  

You’ll need a strong foundation in computer science and software engineering fundamentals, together with curiosity and enthusiasm for solving problems using technology. As this is an early\-career role, we’re interested in your fundamentals, problem\-solving ability, and willingness to learn rather than extensive commercial experience.

  

  

You’ll also need:

  

  

* Strong hands\-on Python programming skills, with an understanding of object\-oriented programming, modular code, and basic software development practices
* Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms, with the ability to apply them effectively when solving programming problems
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to break down problems, evaluate approaches, and translate solutions into working code
* Conceptual understanding of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, including fundamental concepts related to models, training, inference, and data
* Good understanding of software engineering practices, including version control, testing, debugging, and collaborative development
* Ability to learn independently, experiment with unfamiliar technologies, and collaborate effectively within an engineering team. Exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, or Agentic AI is desirable but not essential
  

  

***Candidates who are graduating from or have graduated from colleges we have partnered with will not be considered for this role***
